data.name: Predator's Grace
data.description: You can, as a swift action, grant yourself a +%1-foot bonus to your base speed for 1 round. In addition, you gain low-light vision for 1 round. If you already possess low-light vision, the range of your sight becomes three times that of a human in dim light for 1 round. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|10+floor(DomainLVL/5)*5|DomainAnimalTimes
